items.title: Capim Grosso (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 3 #039
items.en_title: Capim Grosso (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 3 #039
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Capim Grosso (BA) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 93,000; proposals close Dec 3, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
